resources.string: Keeps writing the brightness-dependent UltraHDR hdr/sdr ratio inside system_server — restoring Android 15 semantics where the reported ratio follows the actual panel boost. Requires the companion KSU module (debug.sf.fp16_client_target). See the repository README for the full mechanism.
Hook not active (enable module in LSPosed and reboot)
Granted — log folder is kept under /storage/emulated/0/hdr日志/
Not granted — open SukiSU/KernelSU manager, grant this app, then reopen
Takes effect immediately, no reboot. 0 = same-source bootstrap (recommended), 1 = suppress panel HDR boost (rarely needed once the fp16 module is active).
Disable the ratio bootstrap instantly (checked on every callback — no reboot). Observation hooks keep logging.
Sends SurfaceFlinger transaction 1008 ~15 s after boot (same as “Disable HW overlays”). Fixes DPU tone-mapping flicker on this device. Takes effect after reboot.
Observation logs on/off. Critical diagnostics always log regardless.
Cap the reported HDR/SDR ratio. 0 = unlimited (default). Lower it if highlights clip. The effective ceiling is 4.0 (limited by the OEM curve).
No log yet. Enable “Log to file” and reopen an HDR image.
Nothing captured (module may not be active)
When on, the hardware-accelerated canvas applies the gain map automatically if headroom exists.
Open full HDR test in browser
zyyme.com/hdr-test.html (HDR video needs Chrome; WebView cannot render HDR by platform design).
A dedicated window that only boosts the sample image — HDR mode never leaks into the rest of the app.
Sweeping: %1$s — do not lock the screen
Smoothly ramps 30%→60%→100%, samples the app channel and root truth at each step, writes /sdcard/Download/hdrscan.log (~30s, keep screen on, keep HDR switch ON)
Target: Lenovo Tab Plus-family TB710FU (SM8650), ZUXOS 1.5.04.366 / Android 16
Root + Xposed module. Use at your own risk. This module never writes to brightness or backlight paths.
UltraHDR image boost will stop immediately and the stock NaN behaviour returns. You can re-enable at any time without reboot.
